name: ART 3625
title: Ceramics: Surface Engagement
description: Principles and techniques for surface design and expression in ceramic art. Projects based on a variety of clay forming techniques emphasize two- and three-dimensional ceramic surface mark, image, and color development. Class presentations, discussions and critiques explore ideas and issues in the field of ceramic art. May be repeated for a total of 9 credits.
requirement_description: ART 2610; open only to Art and Art History majors, others by instructor consent.
